title: MENTAL POKER
tagline: An On-chain poker game that you can connect your wallet, bet any tokens you like(So ApeCoin is available!), set NFT as an profile and send chat messages straightly to the wallet.
description: You can connect your wallet on Taiko, Gnosis Chain, Scroll, Polygon and Eth Mainnet. And you can buy-in/cash-out any ERC-20 tokens you like. We're using the Airstack API  to get users' NFT images and token balances, and Push protocol to send the in-game messages by wallet-to-wallet.
how_its_made:
To build the project, you need to separately build the client side and the server side. Additionally, a database needs to be constructed, with SQL located in the database directory. The use of redis-server is also necessary. Furthermore, you need to appropriately set up API keys and passwords.
   
   The technologies used are written in TypeScript and Vue.js, with a basic poker game as the foundation and incorporating many Web3 elements. It starts with a basic wallet connection using MetaMask, game start notifications through the push protocol, and setting profile images by obtaining NFTs using Airstack.
   
   Poker should definitely move away from centralization, making it well-suited for construction on Web3. Moreover, it was easy to support multi-chain, and there was synergy with various projects, including PU protocol and Airstack.
